title: Bar Salts Watermelon Shortfill E-Liquid 100ml By Vampire Vape
description: A simple and authentic watermelon flavour, delivering a bold yet clean and fruity taste with a cool finish, perfect for those fond of the classic Watermelon flavour. These Vampire Vape Bar Salts Shortfills contain 100ml with a 60VG/40PG ratio and are nicotine-free at 0mg. Their 60VG/40PG ratio provides an ideal balance of flavour and vapour and are perfect for use with starter kits and pod systems, and pods/coils with 0.6ohm+ resistances for a rich and flavoursome MTL (mouth-to-lung) vape experience. This range of 60/40 shortfills from Vampire Vape adds a new dimension to their bestselling Bar Salts collection. They include you’re their most iconic Bar Salts flavours, which are inspired by the intense tastes and tactile MTL kick of disposable vapes, but in a far more cost-effective and longer-lasting 100ml bottle. With their 60VG/40POG ratio, they are extremely versatile too, and can be used with a vast variety of MTL kits such as pod kits and starter kits. Each bottle of Vampire Vape Bar Salts shortfill contains 100ml of e-liquid in a 120ml shortfill bottle, with space for 2 x 10ml nicotine shots to let you tailor your e juice’s nicotine content. For example, adding 2 x 10ml, 18mg nic shots will create 120ml of 3mg e-liquid. Check out more flavours from the Bar Salts Shortfill collection from Vampire Vape, featuring many other unique options such as Strawberry Ice, Kiwi Passionfruit Guava and Pineapple Ice.
